## v1.37.0

New options for catalog items and converse turns, a custom-variables lookup, and stricter input checks. Three checks can break existing code, listed under Behavior change.

### Added

- `mgmt.application.getCustomVariables(agentId, ks)` lists the `{{ variables }}` an agent uses, system and custom. Read only. (#435)
- `agentScope` on `catalog.createVoice`, `createVisual`, `createFace`, `createBackground` and `catalog.update`. Pass `''` on update to clear it. It tags an item for listing and is not access control. (#440)
- Converse options `add_message_in_db` (`false` answers a turn without storing it) and `shared_message_id` (starts a new thread from that message). With `recoverFromSpiral`, the retry continues that new thread. An unknown id gives `empty_reply`. (#441)
- `err.serverCode` on a refused session. It holds the server's upper-case reason, such as `INVALID_KS`. `err.code` stays `unsupported_client`. (#438)
- `MODEL_IDS` adds `claude-sonnet-5` and `claude-haiku-4-5`. The JSDoc says which ids answered a live turn. (#442)

### Behavior change

- A request variable whose name starts with lowercase `sys__` throws `validation_error` before any request. The message names the key, never the value. (#436)
- `skills.update` with `patch.name` applies the same character rule as `skills.add` (letters, digits, `_`, `-`). Otherwise it throws `bad_request`. (#436)
- A voice id for `importVoiceFromElevenLabs` or `importVoiceFromCartesia` must be 1 to 128 characters. Otherwise it throws `bad_request`. (#436)

### Docs and skill

- `submitStructuredDataForm()` says the values go to the server and the agent does not see them. Use `speak()` or `updateRequestVars()` to give the agent the values. (#438)
- New size-limits section in `docs/api/operate.md`. (#438)
- Avatar error titles, proven field limits for badges, insight settings and voice names, and a note that replies can differ at `temperature: 0`. (#443)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.36.5...v1.37.0
